notes.title: Game Update 0.14.0
notes.content: [p]Beneath buzzing cicadas and a warm summer breeze, [b]Typing Valley[/b] has shot up a little taller: street-lights glow at dusk, restaurant patrons sport fresh haircuts, and the splash rings when a fish bites are bigger than ever. Step into the valley and see what new stories await![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Fresh Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Character Progress Panel[/b][/p][p]Check your level, portrait, and basic stats at any time and track the life you’ve built in Typing Valley.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Typing Vocabulary 2.0[/b][/p][p]Every interactive object now has a [i]Familiarity[/i] meter. The more you type with it, the more related words you unlock—letting the world “talk back” as your understanding deepens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overhauled Recipes[/b][/p][list][*][p]New [i]ingredient-type[/i] recipes: early cooking is no longer blocked by a single rare fruit—mix and match what you have.[/p][/*][*][p]Fewer seasoning categories for high-tier dishes, so your backpack (and brain) can finally breathe.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Restaurant Guest Makeover[/b][/p][p]Out-of-place NPCs have been permanently retired. Today’s diners switch hairstyles, aprons, and funky socks at random—occasionally you’ll even spot a suit-and-tie visitor escaping office life.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Evolved Day-Night Cycle[/b][/p][p]A re-drawn light curve: softer sunsets, darker midnights. Street-lamps, windows, and fireflies appear on schedule, and the kitchen window glows at dawn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crop Growth Stages[/b][/p][p]Fruit trees and veggies no longer sprout overnight—watch them inch from seedling to harvest with daily visual changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tool Upgrade Path[/b][/p][p]Durability has retired; axes, hammers, and rods now climb an upgrade ladder toward [i]Legendary[/i] status.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lightweight Pop-ups[/b][/p][p]A tidy slip in the lower-left shows loot, stamina recovery, and more—leaving the center of the screen to the scenery.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]World & Atmosphere[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Environmental Additions[/b][/p][p]A playground, sandcastles, deckchairs, and a shower of shooting stars—Typing Valley now feels like a mini holiday.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamped Fish Ponds[/b][/p][p]Every pond has been restocked with species-specific fish—collectors can finally draft a true “Fishing Compendium.”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Night-time Highlights[/b][/p][p]Neon, signs, street-lamps, and window lights illuminate at just the right moments; keep your eyes up on evening jogs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Restaurant Mood Tweaks[/b][/p][p]Alcohol is off the menu—parents can relax. Guest-unlock pacing has been adjusted so you meet familiar faces sooner.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Items & Resources[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Reworked Chest Loot[/b][/p][p]Opening a chest is now worth the thrill—key seasonings and rare tools drop more often.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Higher Seed Drops[/b][/p][p]Fruit and vegetable seeds fall more frequently, turning gathering runs into pleasant surprises.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backpack Upgrade Sooner[/b][/p][p]Reduced friendship threshold means you can haul a bigger bag earlier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ingredients & Gear[/b][/p][p]Dozens of fresh materials join the collection list—kitchens and workbenches just got busier.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Controls & Interaction[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Postal & Museum Typing[/b][/p][p]Long entries auto-paginate and track per-character accuracy—write essays without hiccups.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Localization Pass[/b][/p][p]Blank quests, recipe hints, vocabulary prompts—every missing string is now translated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fishing Feel Upgrade[/b][/p][p]Larger bite ripples, crisper sounds, longer line—learn the rhythm on your very first cast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faint-and-Wake Position Fix[/b][/p][p]On collapse you’ll reappear neatly beside your bed, not wandering by the window at 2 a.m.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]We also shooed away a swarm of mischievous bugs. The full list would scroll for pages, so we’ll let you discover the smoother Typing Valley experience for yourself.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]The valley hums louder with every keystroke you make. May summer breezes, glowing lights, and the gentle return key inspire the next chapter of your warm-hearted adventure.[/p]

notes.title: GameUpdate 0.13.1
notes.content:
[b]System Fixes & UX Improvements[/b]

• Fixed an issue where rewards from the Post Office and Museum were not properly granted—players will now receive their rewards correctly after completing tasks.
• Fixed a bug where fishing spots were not correctly refreshing fish, ensuring a smoother fishing experience across all areas.
• Improved recipe unlocking flow: after unlocking a new recipe, the panel will no longer close automatically, allowing players to continue browsing and managing recipes more easily.

notes.title: Game Update 0.13.0
notes.content:
In this version, we’re excited to bring you a wide range of new features and refinements to further enrich your pastoral life. Every enhancement reflects our dedication to creating a cozy and meaningful experience, all inspired by your valuable feedback. Let’s take a look at what’s new!



[b]New Features & Systems[/b]

• Restaurant – Recipe Unlock & Upgrades: Players can now upgrade dishes by using ingredients, and research new recipes after upgrading the restaurant.
• Orchard System Introduced: Unlock and expand your orchard to grow fruit trees and harvest fruit periodically.
• Fish Farming System Introduced: Unlock and expand the fish pond to raise fish and collect them over time.
• Crop Farming Enhanced: Unlock and expand farmland to grow vegetables and harvest them continuously.
• Museum System Update: Donate rare items to the museum and write heartfelt stories for each exhibit.
• Restaurant Memory Scenes: During restaurant service, friends may recall touching life memories through special visual scenes while enjoying their meals.



[b]Characters & Player Options[/b]

• Captain Character Redesign: The captain has received a complete visual overhaul, bringing a fresh and vivid look to this key NPC.
• New Player Gender Selection: Players can now choose to play as a boy or a girl when starting their adventure.



[b]Control & Interaction Improvements[/b]

• Fixed an issue where stacked items could result in incorrect item types.
• Improved item stacking across multiple chests, making inventory management smoother.
• Players can now customize movement keys, improving compatibility with various keyboard layouts.
• Fixed an issue where certain music and sound effects were not affected by global volume settings.
• Fixed typing accuracy miscalculations in the post office—every character is now properly tracked.
• Typing experience in the Post Office and Museum has been improved: words will no longer be cut off when wrapping lines, and text will scroll smoothly if it exceeds the dialogue box.



[b]Items & Resource Updates[/b]

• Added a large number of new items, including crops, fish, seafood, seasonings, museum artifacts, and advanced dishes.
• Fixed an issue where treasure chests would not drop items correctly.
• Fixed a bug where items dropped on the ground could not be picked up.
• Mining and woodcutting now have a chance to yield museum artifacts, adding more depth to your collection journey.
• Treasure chest drops adjusted, focusing on key seasonings used in recipes to support advanced cooking progression.
• Improved restaurant UI for cooking and recipe combination, making them easier to find and use.



[b]Localization & Language Support[/b]

• Fixed several multilingual display issues, ensuring a smoother experience for players across different languages.



Every update is a reflection of our love for this peaceful countryside world. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—may these changes bring even more joy, emotion, and discovery to your farm journey!

notes.title: 0.12.4 Game Update
notes.content:
To ensure your pastoral moments remain as smooth and comfortable as possible, we’ve meticulously refined and optimized the game—every change inspired by your invaluable feedback. Here are the warm improvements introduced in this update:

[b]Game Settings and Control Support[/b]
• Supports various keyboard layouts, ensuring more accurate typing input (default movement keys on non-QWER keyboards are still under optimization).
• Both the Enter key and the Space bar can now be used as confirmation keys for more flexible operation.
• Pressing the Space bar quickly expands character dialogue, making interactions more convenient.
• New game setting: toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode.
• New game setting: adjust music and sound effect volumes.
• New game setting: customize movement keys (WASD or ESDF).

[b]Core Gameplay and Controls[/b]
• Made food items edible—consuming them now restores stamina.
• When a word input error occurs, the game no longer restarts; instead, a shaking animation cues you to continue typing.
• Slightly increased the main character’s movement speed to enhance the exploration experience.

[b]Store and Inventory Management[/b]
• Added a storage chest outside the restaurant, allowing players to store items.
• Upgraded storage chest functionality: one-click store, remove all items, and organize inventory options are now available.
• Introduced a new in-game shop for item sales, offering a wider range of choices.

[b]Fishing and Treasure Chest System[/b]
• Removed the fake bite-hook action during fishing, resulting in a smoother experience.
• Enhanced the fishing and treasure chest systems with a chance to yield multiple items at once, keeping the surprises coming!

[b]Map and Exploration Enhancements[/b]
• Added signposts at the entrance of each road, clearly indicating interactive points at the end.
• Adjusted the spawn rate of fruits in town, making harvesting feel more natural and engaging.

[b]Interface and Visual Updates[/b]
• Completely overhauled the interface with a brand-new design for a more refined and cohesive visual experience.
• Added a total playtime display so you can keep track of your gaming duration.
• Formalized certain in-game objects for enhanced detail.
• Extra content in character dialogue boxes is now hidden to prevent overflow.
• The settlement panel now correctly displays icons for vocabulary, high-APM words, and incorrect words.

[b]Sound Effects and Music[/b]
• Replaced certain sound effects to enhance overall audio quality.
• Updated the background music to create an entirely new atmosphere.

[b]Multilingual Support and Text Corrections[/b]
• Optimized multilingual processing across various areas to minimize instances of Chinese text appearing in the English version.
• Corrected several text errors to improve overall language quality.

[b]Other Enhancements[/b]
• Added a progress bar indicator to the special guest’s temporary eating scene for more intuitive interaction.

Every update reflects our passion and dedication to this warm pastoral world. Thank you for your continued support and feedback—may these changes add even more fun and surprises to your farm journey!

notes.title: GameUpdate 0.12.3
notes.content:
To ensure that your pastoral moments are even smoother and more comfortable, we’ve once again made meticulous optimizations and adjustments to the game—every change inspired by our heartfelt attention to your invaluable feedback. Check out the warm improvements brought by this update!

[b]Community Interaction[/b]
• Added a Discord community portal, so players can now join discussions and provide feedback more conveniently, helping us build an even better farm life together.

[b]Gameplay Experience Optimization[/b]
• Adjusted the restaurant seating width to give guests a more spacious environment and clearer word displays, enhancing the ordering experience.
• Modified the input keys for wild vegetable gathering to avoid conflicts with movement controls, ensuring smoother operation.
• Optimized the display layering on the customer order screen so that the words are shown more clearly and distinctly.
• Added numerical hotkey prompts to the main interface quick access bar, making navigation more intuitive and effortless.
• Corrected Kacey’s animation direction so that her movements appear more natural—she no longer seems to be “talking behind” the player.

[b]Art and Interface Updates[/b]
• A large number of in-game images have now been replaced with official icons, resulting in a more unified and refined visual experience.
• Updated the game’s start background to a brand-new design, allowing you to feel the warm charm of the countryside as soon as you launch the game.
• The daily settlement background has been refreshed, adding a touch of warmth to your end-of-day summary.
• The layout of the daily settlement interface has been optimized and specially adapted for 16:10 screens, ensuring that overlapping issues no longer occur.
• Disabled certain temporary animation assets for customers.
• The Steam library artwork has also been optimized, providing you with an even more refined visual experience.

[b]Map and Exploration Enhancements[/b]
• Adjusted obstacle settings on the town map to effectively prevent players from inadvertently entering fishponds, ensuring a smoother journey.
• Meticulously repositioned treasure chests on the forest map to ensure that every hidden gem can be easily discovered.
• Optimized the initial fruit distribution on town fruit trees to create a more natural and engaging harvesting rhythm.
• Adjusted chest drop rates to boost the generosity of treasure drops, ensuring an abundance of lucky finds.
• Swapped the character models in the museum to fix display issues, so that the “soul swapping” phenomenon no longer occurs.
• Optimized the player entry points in each mine level to prevent getting stuck, ensuring a smoother exploration experience.

[b]Store Updates[/b]
• The Steam library, announcements, community, game icons, and more have also been optimized, delivering an even more refined visual experience.

Every update reflects our passion and dedication to this warm pastoral world. Thank you for your continuous support and feedback—may these changes add even more fun and surprises to your farm journey!

notes.title: Game Update - 0.12.2
notes.content:
Typing Valley receives a brand-new upgrade! This update not only brings a wealth of new content, but also finely refines the details to present you with a more authentic and natural countryside experience. Here are the detailed updates—let’s take a look!


[b]New Additions[/b]
• The mine map now features three brand-new terrains, adding more mystery and excitement to underground exploration.
• A new guest has joined the restaurant, enhancing the lively dining experience with extra interaction.
• Several new ponds have been added to the town map, decorating the town with a more vibrant scenery.



[b]Visual Updates[/b]
• The robot in the restaurant has been replaced with official resources, boasting a more refined and realistic appearance.
• The proportions of the friends in the restaurant have been adjusted to the correct scale, ensuring more natural and coordinated interactions.
• The idle animation speed for all NPCs has been adjusted to be more relaxed, reflecting the serene pace of life.
• All types of fruit trees now have the proper shapes, showcasing a more natural growth state.
• Fruit trees across all maps have been rearranged according to their natural habits, creating a realistic natural landscape.
• The mine entrance on the town map has been meticulously modified to better match the ruins style, adding an element of mystery.
• Icon resources for fruits, tools, and more have been updated to their official versions, unifying the visual effect.


[b]Store Page Optimization[/b]
• The promotional images, game screenshots, and logo on the Steam store landing page have all been updated to better capture the farming and serene pastoral atmosphere.


Every update is designed to make this ranch an even better place. Thank you all for your continuous support and enthusiasm. We hope these changes bring more warmth and surprises to your countryside life! If you have any suggestions or encounter any issues, please feel free to share your feedback. We will continue working hard to create an even more beautiful ranch world with you!

notes.title: GamePatch 0.12.1
notes.content:
Typing Valley is getting a fresh upgrade! This update fixes many “little hiccups” and adds plenty of heartwarming new features and adjustments, making your countryside adventures even more relaxing and cozy. Check out the details below!

[b]New Content[/b]
• Two New NPCs: Two new residents have arrived in town, replacing placeholder assets. Their presence makes the restaurant livelier and more fun.
• Save Management Feature: Players can now delete saves and embark on a brand-new adventure.
• New Forest Map: The lush forest is brimming with resources. Explore it and uncover delightful surprises!
• New Mine Map: The underground world is full of mysterious allure. Prepare your tools and dig up treasures to your heart’s content!


[b]Game Guidance Enhancements[/b]
• First Login Guidance: A warm introductory message now greets first-time players, explaining that the game revolves around typing with the keyboard—no mouse needed.
• Login Screen Tips: New tips help players learn how to activate menu features by typing the correct words, providing clearer guidance.
• Starting Item Fix: New players will now begin with a trusty axe to kickstart their farming journey.
• Restaurant Design Optimization: Restaurant furniture layout, upgrade options, and management entrances have been improved to make these features easier to find.
• Enhanced Upgrade Animations: Upgrading the restaurant now feels more impactful with enhanced animations for a stronger sense of progression.
• Backpack Improvements: Page numbers have been added to the backpack display, along with a “Tab Key” toggle prompt for easier navigation.


[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
• Restaurant Revival Materials: New assets for the desolate state of the restaurant have been added. Start restoring it and bring it back to life!
• Nighttime Lighting Adjustments: Nighttime brightness has been increased slightly for a softer, more inviting glow. The pastoral nights are no longer pitch dark.
• NPC Appearance Enhancements: Temporary NPC portrait placeholders have been replaced, giving characters a more polished and vivid look.
• NPC Movement and Animation Fixes: NPCs have regained their walking and idle (breathing) animations, making the town livelier than ever!
• Improved NPC Lighting: Fixed an issue where NPCs were unaffected by lighting changes, ensuring their appearances feel more realistic.
• Timeline Interaction Fixes: NPCs and the main character now face each other correctly during Timeline interactions, making conversations more natural.
• Scene Camera Adjustments: Camera angles in the restaurant and bedroom have been centered for a more visually harmonious experience.


[b]Interaction Enhancements[/b]
• Dialogue Range Improvement: Interacting with NPCs no longer requires an awkward “shake” to enter the dialogue range. Conversations now trigger smoothly.
• Backpack Fixes: Fixed an issue where selecting an empty backpack slot would still leave the character in the state of the previously equipped item.
• Fishing Rod Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where the fishing rod wasn’t correctly unequipped after switching tools, preventing accidental use.
• Optimized Spacebar Priority: When typing correctly, typing tasks take priority over tool use, ensuring no unintended actions (like swinging an axe or casting a fishing rod).


[b]Text and UI Enhancements[/b]
• Improved Font Library: Addressed issues with incomplete Chinese text rendering for a smoother visual experience.
• UI Font Adjustments: Fonts, outlines, and sizes have been optimized to make interface text clearer.
• Improved Item Text: Adjusted the fonts, sizes, and styles of item labels, making dropped items easier to see and interact with.


[b]Additional Optimizations[/b]
• Adjusted Day Length: Time now flows slightly slower, giving you more moments to savor the joys of farm life.
• Treasure Chest Changes: All chests now contain rewards—no more empty disappointments! Opened chests will remain open until they are refreshed the next day.
• Fishing Experience Fixes: Fixed issues with bobber placement after a fish bites, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable fishing experience.
• Numpad Support: You can now adjust item quantities using the “+” and “-” keys on your numpad for more efficient management.
• System Interface Tips Fixes: Switching to the item page now correctly displays tips, and closing the system interface will properly dismiss them.


Every update aims to make this pastoral haven even better. Thank you for your support and company! We hope these changes make your countryside adventures even cozier and more enjoyable. If you have suggestions or spot any issues, feel free to let us know—we’re always working to improve! 🌾
